name: Heat Pump Water Heater Program
titleTag: Heat Pump Water Heater Rebates | Vancouver WA Savings
metaDescription: Upgrade to an energy-saving heat pump water heater and get up to $600 back with Clark Public Utilities' rebate. Lower bills, more efficiency.
altText: Bright utility room featuring a modern heat pump water heater—an energy-saving solution eligible for the Heat Pump Water Heater Rebate Program.
content:
Hot water is one of the biggest energy costs in most homes—but upgrading to a heat pump water heater can make a major difference. With Clark Public Utilities' rebate program, you can receive up to $600 back when you replace your old electric water heater with a qualified, ENERGY STAR® certified model.

Heat pump water heaters use advanced technology to extract heat from the surrounding air and transfer it to the water tank—making them up to 3 times more efficient than traditional electric models. That means big savings on your utility bills and a faster return on investment.

At HVA Climate Control, we help you select the right unit, install it professionally, and ensure it meets all the requirements for the rebate.

Program Details:

  • $300–$600 rebate depending on system size and energy rating
  • Must replace an electric resistance water heater (tank-style)
  • Unit must be ENERGY STAR® certified and listed on BPA Qualified Products List
  • Home must be electrically heated and located in Clark County
  • Limited to existing homes (not new construction)

Whether you're upgrading for efficiency or your current tank is nearing the end of its life, this program is a smart way to save. Plus, heat pump water heaters typically come with built-in smart features, longer warranties, and quieter operation.

Our team handles the full process—from helping you choose a qualifying unit to ensuring the paperwork is submitted correctly. All you have to do is enjoy long-term savings and reliable hot water.

Source: Clark Public Utilities

name: Smart Thermostat Program
titleTag: Smart Thermostat Rebate | Vancouver WA Energy Savings
metaDescription: Get a $50 rebate on ENERGY STAR® smart thermostats through Clark Public Utilities. Save energy automatically with smarter climate control.
altText: Modern smart thermostat mounted on a wall in a bright living space—highlighting home energy efficiency improvements supported by the Smart Thermostat Rebate Program.
content:
Smart Thermostat Rebate Details

Smart thermostats are a simple upgrade with a big impact. Through Clark Public Utilities' Smart Thermostat Program, homeowners can receive a $50 rebate when they purchase and install an eligible ENERGY STAR® certified smart thermostat.

These devices go beyond traditional controls by learning your schedule, optimizing heating and cooling usage, and helping you lower your energy bills automatically. With features like remote control via smartphone and real-time usage tracking, smart thermostats make it easy to stay comfortable and efficient year-round.

At HVA Climate Control, we help you choose and install the right thermostat that qualifies for the rebate and works seamlessly with your HVAC system. Whether you're replacing a manual thermostat or upgrading from a basic digital one, this is a fast, affordable way to improve your home's energy performance.

Program Requirements:

  • Rebate: $50 for each qualifying ENERGY STAR® smart thermostat
  • Thermostat must be installed in a primary residence heated with electricity
  • Limit: Up to two thermostats per household
  • Application must be submitted with proof of purchase and installation
  • Can be DIY or professionally installed

This program is ideal for homeowners looking to take a small but effective step toward energy efficiency. When paired with a high-efficiency heat pump system, smart thermostats can help you maximize savings and comfort across every season.

Learn More at Clark Public Utilities:
Smart Thermostat Program Info

What Is a Smart Thermostat?

A smart thermostat is a modern upgrade to traditional temperature control systems. It connects to your Wi-Fi and allows you to manage your home’s heating and cooling from your smartphone, tablet, or voice assistant. These devices can learn your routines, adjust temperatures automatically, and provide insights into your energy use. When paired with a smart thermostat rebate, they become an affordable first step toward home energy efficiency.

Benefits of Smart Thermostats for Homeowners

Installing a smart thermostat provides more than just convenience. Homeowners can benefit from:

  • Lower monthly energy bills through optimized temperature settings
  • Reduced environmental impact with more efficient HVAC usage
  • Remote access and control for on-the-go adjustments
  • Enhanced comfort with learning algorithms that adapt to your lifestyle
    When you apply for the smart thermostat rebate, these benefits come with added savings.

How to Qualify for the Smart Thermostat Rebate

To be eligible for the $50 smart thermostat rebate from Clark Public Utilities, you must:

  • Purchase an ENERGY STAR® certified smart thermostat
  • Install it in a primary residence that is electrically heated
  • Submit a completed application with proof of purchase and installation
    Both DIY and professional installations qualify. HVA Climate Control can ensure you select a qualifying device and complete the setup correctly.

Best Thermostat Brands That Qualify

Some of the most popular smart thermostat brands that typically qualify for the rebate include:

  • Google Nest
  • ecobee
  • Honeywell Home
  • Emerson Sensi
    These models are ENERGY STAR® certified and compatible with many HVAC systems. HVA Climate Control can help you choose a brand and model that fits your needs and budget while ensuring it qualifies for the rebate.

Combine Smart Thermostats with Other Energy-Saving Upgrades

For maximum efficiency, consider combining your smart thermostat installation with other upgrades, such as:

  • Ductless mini-split systems
  • Heat pump installations
  • Improved insulation and weather sealing
    Smart thermostats are most effective when working alongside modern, energy-efficient HVAC systems. By claiming the smart thermostat rebate and upgrading your HVAC system, you can dramatically reduce your home’s energy consumption.

altText: Stylish living room with a wall-mounted ductless heat pump system—perfect example of energy-efficient upgrades eligible for the Ductless Heat Pump Rebate Program.
content:
Ductless Heat Pump Rebate Details

Ductless heat pumps offer an efficient, cost-effective way to heat and cool your home—especially for properties without existing ductwork. Through the Clark Public Utilities Ductless Heat Pump Program, qualified homeowners can receive up to $1,200 in rebates when upgrading their current heating systems.

At HVA Climate Control, we help homeowners across Vancouver and Clark County access these incentives while ensuring expert installation and energy savings. Ductless systems—also known as mini-splits—are ideal for electrically heated homes, additions, or rooms that are difficult to keep comfortable.

Program Details:

  • Up to $800–$1,200 in rebates depending on system type and home eligibility
  • Must replace existing electric resistance heat (such as baseboards, cadet heaters, or wall units)
  • Installations must be performed by a Clark Public Utilities-approved contractor
  • Energy-efficient, inverter-driven systems required for rebate qualification

Ductless heat pumps are compact, whisper-quiet, and highly efficient. These systems allow for zoned temperature control—giving you the ability to heat or cool only the spaces you use. Homeowners love the flexible comfort, low operating costs, and long-term reliability.

As an experienced local contractor, HVA Climate Control ensures your system meets all eligibility criteria, handles rebate paperwork, and installs your new ductless system to the highest standards.

Official Program Info:
Clark Public Utilities – Ductless Heat Pump Program

What Is a Ductless Heat Pump?

Ductless heat pumps—also called mini-split systems—offer an energy-efficient solution for heating and cooling homes without the need for traditional ductwork. These systems provide targeted climate control by allowing homeowners to condition individual rooms or zones instead of the entire home at once. Perfect for older homes, additions, or rooms that are difficult to keep comfortable, ductless systems are compact, quiet, and highly effective year-round.

Benefits of Ductless Heat Pump Systems

Upgrading to a ductless heat pump system provides several advantages, including:

  • Zoned temperature control for personalized comfort
  • Reduced energy consumption and lower utility bills
  • Whisper-quiet indoor operation
  • Compact design with flexible installation options
  • Enhanced indoor air quality with multi-stage filtration
    When paired with local rebate programs, these systems become an affordable long-term investment in home comfort and efficiency.

Eligibility for the Ductless Heat Pump Rebate Program

Homeowners in Vancouver and Clark County may qualify for a rebate when replacing older, inefficient heating systems with an approved ductless heat pump. General eligibility requirements include:

  • Replacing an existing electric resistance heat source (such as baseboards, wall heaters, or cadet units)
  • Using an energy-efficient inverter-driven system
  • Having installation performed by a participating contractor
    HVA Climate Control ensures your equipment meets all necessary rebate criteria and guides you through the application process from start to finish.

Trusted Brands & Models We Recommend

We work with a variety of top-performing ductless heat pump brands known for their reliability and energy efficiency, including:

  • Mitsubishi Electric
  • Daikin
  • Fujitsu
  • LG
    Each brand offers systems that qualify for rebates and perform well in the Pacific Northwest climate.

Why Choose HVA Climate Control?

As a licensed and experienced local HVAC contractor, HVA Climate Control specializes in designing and installing ductless systems tailored to your home’s specific needs. We:

  • Handle rebate paperwork and ensure eligibility
  • Help you select the right system size and model
  • Provide expert installation to maximize efficiency and comfort
  • Offer maintenance support to extend the life of your system
    We’re proud to help Clark County homeowners reduce energy use while increasing comfort with ductless heat pump technology.

name: Heat Pump Program
titleTag: Heat Pump Program Rebates | Save Energy & Money
metaDescription: Upgrade to an energy-efficient heat pump and get rebates through our local utility partner. Save energy and cut your heating bills.
altText: Modern basement utility room featuring a newly installed heat pump system—ideal for homeowners exploring energy savings through the Heat Pump Rebate Program.
content:
Heat Pump Rebate Details

Our Heat Pump Program is designed to help Vancouver and Clark County homeowners make the switch to high-efficiency electric heat pumps while saving money through valuable rebates offered by Clark Public Utilities.

As your local HVAC experts, HVA Climate Control can help you take advantage of rebate incentives of up to $1,000 for qualifying installations. Whether you're replacing an outdated furnace or switching from electric baseboard heat, installing a heat pump can dramatically reduce your energy use and monthly utility bills. These systems offer both heating and cooling from a single unit—perfect for Pacific Northwest climate conditions.

Program Highlights:

  • Rebates available for new installations and upgrades
  • Eligible homeowners can receive $500 to $1,000 depending on system type and installation scope
  • Projects must be completed by a Clark Public Utilities-approved contractor (like us!)
  • Duct sealing and energy-efficiency standards must be met
  • Additional incentives for ductless and variable-speed systems

Heat pumps are one of the most energy-efficient HVAC options available. They pull warmth from the outside air—even in colder weather—requiring far less electricity than traditional heating systems. By participating in this program, you not only increase home comfort but also contribute to a cleaner, greener community.

At HVA Climate Control, we guide you through the full process—from evaluating your eligibility to ensuring your system meets all utility requirements for maximum rebate payout.

Learn more from Clark PUD Heat Pump Program

What Is a Heat Pump and Why Upgrade?

A heat pump is one of the most efficient heating and cooling systems available today. Unlike traditional furnaces that generate heat, heat pumps transfer warmth from the outside air—even in cold weather—to efficiently warm your home. In the summer, they reverse the process to provide cooling. For homeowners in the Pacific Northwest, they offer year-round comfort with dramatically lower energy use.

Benefits of Installing a High-Efficiency Heat Pump

Making the switch to a modern electric heat pump brings a variety of benefits:

  • Lower monthly energy bills due to reduced power consumption
  • Heating and cooling from a single, all-in-one system
  • Consistent indoor comfort across seasons
  • Quiet operation and compact system design
  • Reduced environmental impact from clean, electric operation
    When installed with ductwork upgrades or in place of electric resistance heat, heat pumps can significantly boost home efficiency.

Who Qualifies for the Heat Pump Incentive?

Clark Public Utilities offers generous rebates for homeowners who meet certain criteria. While specific qualifications vary by system and home type, general requirements include:

  • Must be replacing electric baseboard, wall heaters, or a furnace
  • Installation must be completed by a utility-approved contractor (like HVA Climate Control)
  • Duct sealing and minimum system performance standards must be met
  • Certain models of ductless and variable-speed systems may qualify for additional incentives
    We’ll help you verify your eligibility and ensure your system meets all utility requirements.

Why Heat Pumps Are Ideal for the Pacific Northwest

The mild climate of Southwest Washington makes it ideal for electric heat pump performance. These systems excel in regions where winters are cool but not extreme, and summers are mild to moderate. That’s why Clark Public Utilities continues to promote heat pump adoption—they work efficiently in our climate, reduce load on the grid, and help homeowners save money.

Let HVA Climate Control Handle Your Heat Pump Project

From product selection to final installation and rebate paperwork, HVA Climate Control is your local expert in efficient heating and cooling solutions. We:

  • Recommend models that qualify for Clark Public Utilities incentives
  • Ensure proper sizing and installation for your home
  • Guide you through the rebate process for maximum savings
  • Provide long-term maintenance and service options
    We’ve helped countless Clark County homeowners make the switch to high-efficiency heating. Let’s do the same for your home.
